subject: Sealed-site proof package & signer roster for isolated-cluster update
messages:
From: Elena Morales <security@acmeenergy.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: proof package + signer list for isolated-cluster update

Hi Marissa,

Per our onboarding call, Acme Security needs the full "proof package" for the upcoming sealed-site update you proposed for our isolated cluster. Specifically we need: 

- Signed artifact manifest (checksums + signature)
- Signer roster with roles and public key fingerprints
- Delivery & acceptance procedure for removable media (courier + handoff)
- Expected activation window and rollback criteria

Could you attach the minimal proof package and a short checklist we can run during acceptance? We also prefer Ed25519 signatures where possible.

Attached: acme-update-questionnaire.pdf (filled)

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Lead: Infrastructure Security
Acme Energy

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <security@acmeenergy.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: proof package + signer list for isolated-cluster update

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned on Ed25519 and removable-media delivery. High-level plan attached and summarized below.

Summary (what we'll deliver):
- "Proof package" ZIP containing: artifact-manifest.json (SHA-256 checksums), artifact-manifest.sig (Ed25519 signature), signed-operator-certs.pem (X.509 bundle of operator public keys), and a short acceptance-checklist.txt.
- Signer roster CSV with name, role, signing-key-fingerprint, and on-site contact.
- Transport plan: double-encrypted disk image (LUKS), courier sealed, transporter handoff signed by courier via DocuSign link. Checksums and signature will be transmitted over a separate channel (PGP-signed email and a HubSpot record).
- Dry-run: we propose a dry-run of the checksum/verify step one week prior to activation.

Attached for initial review: proof-package-index.json, signer-roster.csv (redacted). The full signed bundle will be produced and couriered on your go/no-go.

Links: acceptance folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleProofPackage
DocuSign preview: https://app.docusign.com/ACME-ENCRYPTED-SIGN-12345

Next steps requested from Acme: please confirm the activation window you prefer (we tentatively hold Sept 28 02:00-04:00 UTC), and confirm who on your side will run the acceptance checklist.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of On-Prem Deployments
Redwood Inference

[attachment stubs: proof-package-index.json (text), signer-roster.csv (csv)]
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <security@acmeenergy.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: proof package + signer list for isolated-cluster update

Elena / team — sharing signer details and key material notes below. I kept the courier and operator contact fields intentionally minimal for the public thread; full certs will be in the encrypted bundle.

Signer roster (short):
- Priyom Das — Release Engineer (primary signer) — ed25519:F6A3:9C2B:... (fingerprint truncated)
- Rishi Malhotra — Platform Security (backup signer) — ed25519:1B8D:4E51:...
- Operator-Signer-Group (3-key quorum) — keys listed in operator-signature-certs.pem

Signature & format notes:
- All manifests signed with Ed25519 using RFC8032 format.
- artifact-manifest.json contains per-file SHA-256 and a manifest-level timestamp.
- artifact-manifest.sig is detached; verification command (example):
  gpg --import operator-signature-certs.pem 
  ed25519-verify artifact-manifest.sig artifact-manifest.json

Transport checklist (high level):
- Disk image encrypted with LUKS, AES-XTS + separate passphrase stored in customer KMS (split knowledge).
- Courier sealed with tamper-evident tags; handoff signed in DocuSign and recorded in HubSpot (HS-54621).
- On-site operator performs checksum verification using our verify script (tools/verify-artifact.sh) before activation.

I'll drop the actual operator-signature-certs.pem and artifact-manifest.sig in the encrypted bundle on rule of receipt.

Attaching: operator-signature-certs.pem (stub), artifact-manifest.sig (stub)

--
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Deployment Security
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: proof package + signer list for isolated-cluster update

Thanks — Acme, this looks good from our side.

We confirm the activation window Sept 28 02:00-04:00 UTC. Operational notes and next steps: 
- We will produce the encrypted bundle and hand over to NorthStar Logistics (courier_ops@northstar-sys.com) for physical delivery on Sept 25.
- Dry-run: proposed Sept 21 18:00 UTC (30-minute remote session) where Acme runs the verify-artifact.sh against the manifest we post to the drive link. Please confirm who will be on the call.
- Acceptance criteria: checksum match (per-file), signature verification passes, and operator on-site signs the acceptance form. Fallback: if verification fails, we revert to the prior image and open a hotfix SR.

I have created HubSpot record HS-54621 and will add courier tracking and DocuSign completion there.

Elena — if you confirm participants for the dry-run I will schedule the calendar invite and share the remote verification checklist.

Priyom Das
Release Engineer, Redwood Inference
